resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register build field reads 1936, which is the replacement cabin. The register description says the first structure was completed before the 1911 fire season, so the record's 1936 is the replacement year, not the first build. The exact year of the first structure is not given.

notes_for_editor: Two sources. The first structure's exact year is not given, so no build event is dated before 1936 (the 1911 staffing event is a separate fact). Staffing rests on one October 1911 Morning Union item quoted by Forest Lookouts. One WebSearch returned a Columbia Hill schoolhouse in North Columbia and nearby lookouts, nothing on this lookout. Brief record checked: kind, county, agency, coordinates and built year (1936 register field) match. No access facts written: no source read describes public access.
